sections.text: I Bestow The Miracle of Tone to You

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 390. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 40 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 120 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Removes special status ailments.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Removes debuffs and special debuffs.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
Only [Tone Angel] Hatsune Miku x Airi can be used as Unlocking Potential material
